about: Hand-mapped faults from the DARK retrospective. expected_ids are the entries (or slice:<name>) the ideal gate for the ticket should flag; earliest_step_visible is the events.json seq from which every expected id is live and the fault is present in the graph. The harness refuses a case whose ids are missing, unborn or retired at that event.

cases.note: S-35's body imports Observed from dark.inconsistency.apply, the module S-18's Module line declares (S-18 born 112); S-35 has no depends_on at all. Visible from S-35's birth until it retired at 1310 (cut 7).

S-130 imports RunStore/Record/DerivedStore (S·26/S·32/S·33) and Role/store_root (S·52) by id, depends_on is empty. The cited ids were already retired (into S-74/S-109/S-75/S-88), so the gate must resolve a body id to its live successor's module.

S-259's fixtures build source runs through dark/control/cell.py (S-250, live from 1724) and T-429 flies the loop; the contract names the loop 'in prose rather than as an edge' to avoid a slice cycle. Neither S-250 nor the loop entry is in depends_on.
S-270 lacks S-228 (dark/experiment/admissibility.py, live since 1669). The contract never states the call; it lives only in the T-287 scenario, so a gate reading S bodies alone cannot catch this one.

T-664 (under S-127, born 1252) imports dark.metrics.catalogue (S-115 at the time) and dark.record.outcome (S-29); S-127 has no depends_on. S-127 sits in legibility, cross-cutting until event 1504, so no outbound depends_on was expressible at all (see the M8 case).
S-207 imports 'Rates (S·cell)', an unresolved placeholder id; its tests import dark.control.cell, declared by S-250 from 1724. S-207's depends_on never gains S-250.
T-698 judges S-264 against the declaration in dark/estimation/filtered.py (S-268, born 1832); S-264 has no edge to it. S-264 retired at 1844.
T-447 needs dark.control.cell (S-250, from 1724) and the builders delegate to direct.py / filtered.py; S-77 depends only on S-34.

S-04's resolve.py imports schema.py (S-03); the body says 'Not expressible as an edge -- the same-slice depends_on restriction'. Both are in legibility, and today's rules admit a same-slice edge, so the gate flags the missing one.
S-308's tests (T-575/T-576) can only run once S-305's dark/report/render.py exists (S-305 born 1994); S-308 has no depends_on to S-305.
S-244 names configs/thin.toml as the smallest admissible configuration; no Module line in the whole history declares that path (S-10/S-16/S-71 named it from 108).
S-06 specifies the package surface in dark/config/__init__.py (T-93 checks it); no Module line ever declares dark/config/__init__.py.
S-127 re-exports SweepConfig/ReportConfig through dark/config/__init__.py, which no Module line declares (verify_note: the 'no unit' claim came from the implementer, but the snapshot agrees).
S-07 places the exit-code policy in dark/health/__main__.py while its Module line holds only verdict.py; the path is first declared by S-134 at 1304, which retires S-07 at 1305.
S-278 names .github/workflows/ci.yml (its lineage has since S-12 at 108); no Module line declares it -- S-287 later claims it in prose only.

S-31's contract has RunRegion.seal (region.py, S-25) call summarise and read.py (S-32) pass the summary through, but its Module line holds only events.py. The files are owned, by others: this is the 'in the declaring unit's write set when it modifies them' half of the gate.

S-12 (project-health) depends_on S-08 (experiment-definition), both wave 0 and authored concurrently; the id was allocated to the other slice at commit. Lived from 108 to 113, before cut 1 -- only a per-amendment replay sees it.

The run-record session's first block depends_on project-health's A-05/A-06/A-08 (born 52), a wave-0 sibling being written at the same time; admitted sound. The finding counts five edges, the snapshot shows six on these five entries. Same event as m1103-1. A-11/A-12/A-15 retired at 55.

S-34's sweep allows variant-name literals only in variant.py and the four variant modules; S-69 requires dark/config/schema.py to hold VARIANT_NAMES as a literal tuple. The sweep's test is T-347 (from 262).
S-60's sweep fails any '.create(' under dark/metrics and dark/report; S-116 must memoise through Corpus.derived().create.
S-114's import allowlist refuses dark.record.facts/region and admits dark.record.read only in central.py and tuning.py; S-247 (anchor.py) and S-271 (central.py) require imports it refuses.
S-285 tells loop.py to emit policy facts 'unless direct'; the variant-name sweep (T-669, successor of T-347) bans that literal in loop.py and the contract names no other discriminator.
S-269's filtered.py defines _ekf/_ukf/_naive builders; the variant-naming sweep (T-669) allowlists only direct/ekf/ukf/central and forbids variant-name literals in filtered.py.

S-23 gives the AMBIENT regex as a literal containing 'urllib' and 'requests'; placed verbatim in determining.py it matches its own line under T-04's sweep. The sweep collides with the entry that declares it.

The live spec entries with no Module line at cut 3 (work_units event 285); 'complete' was true. The plan's '68 at cut 3' is not reproducible: verify_note says the figure is not in the records, 68 is cut 1's whole live S count, and the snapshot has no module-declaration history -- every other S body carried a Module line from birth.
S-196 types FIGURES and regenerate() over Analysis; no live entry defines Analysis's module, fields or constructor.
S-195 says a declared prediction naming a cell outside the space raises at construction (T-564) but defines no prediction type, constructor or exception.
S-77 declares ChannelSpec('command', '<f8', (cell.n_drones, 3)); Cell (S-38 at the time, later S-250) has no n_drones field.
S-251 records truth.state as (n, 6), position and velocity, straight from plant.truth(); the Plant (S-87) returns S-13's Snapshot(t, positions) with no velocity (T-255 needs it too).

legibility is cross-cutting until the classification at 1504 although callers branch on what it returns (resolve, ConfigError, RunConfig): 23 of 56 A entries consume A-01. A ratification-time check flags the slice, not an entry.
At cut 42 (work_units 2103) every gate was clean, yet A-145 requires every tuning to be reported and tune() had no caller: no S entry provides the observable.

B-44's observable test is 'one documented command' producing a result; at cut 42 there was no study sweep, config or just recipe (verify_note: B-44's wording is not in the cited records, but it is the entry's own text in the snapshot).
